items.title: 19th Urban Mobility India Conference opens in Bhubaneswar
items.text: The Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs reported that the 2026 conference and exhibition was inaugurated by Union Minister of State Tokhan Sahu on 23 October. Policymakers and transport specialists are discussing accessible, liveable cities, digital mobility, intelligent transport and sustainable public transport; 28 exhibitors are presenting urban-transport solutions.

items.title: India's private-sector activity reaches a four-month high in October
items.text: The HSBC Flash India Composite Purchasing Managers' Index rose to 56.7 in October from 55.9 in September, signalling expansion. Services activity strengthened to 56.2, while manufacturing eased to 54.9. New orders and export demand improved, although companies remained cautious about hiring because existing staff could handle workloads.

items.title: Atmanirbhar Bharat – Destination Himachal Expo 2026 opens in Chamba
items.text: A three-day national-level science, innovation and industry exhibition opened at the historic Chaugan Ground on Friday. Scientific institutions, government organisations, artisans, farmers and local entrepreneurs are taking part, creating a shared platform to present research, technology, traditional skills and local enterprise.

items.title: Andhra Pradesh calls for universities to strengthen research and innovation
items.text: At the Chancellors Conclave 2026 in Goa, Andhra Pradesh's science, technology and innovation secretary Dr H. Purushotham urged universities to become stronger centres for research, entrepreneurship and technology. Priorities included industry partnerships, AI and quantum-computing education, improved research infrastructure and greater patent generation.

items.title: India beats New Zealand by four wickets in the first T20I
items.text: India chased a target of 226 and finished on 230 for six in 19.4 overs at Hagley Oval in Christchurch, taking a 1–0 lead in the five-match series. Sanju Samson scored 67 from 33 balls, while Naman Dhir remained unbeaten on 42 to help complete the chase.
